humanities_role_explanation: The study targets iconographic classification of Christian saints using Iconclass, an art-historical competence (identifying subject matter via attributes), rather than using artworks as generic image data. It is framed as supporting metadata curation in art-historical/DH workflows.
benchmark_modalities_explanation: Paintings (images) are classified by VLMs/multimodal LLMs using text prompts containing class labels or Iconclass descriptions; few-shot adds exemplar images with labels.
analytical_tasks_explanation: Single-label classification of paintings into the 10 most frequent Christian saint classes (Iconclass codes), under zero-shot with labels, zero-shot with Iconclass descriptions, and few-shot with five exemplars. This is closer to recognition of saints by attributes than deeper iconological interpretation.

general_purpose_benchmark.note: Scoped to a single task (single-label classification of Christian saints) in one domain.

evaluates_generative_llm.note: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash, plus CLIP and SigLIP variants.

summary: The paper benchmarks CLIP, SigLIP, GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 models on single-label classification of Christian saints across ArtDL, an Iconclass AI Test Set subset and a Wikidata set. It compares zero-shot labels, zero-shot with Iconclass descriptions and few-shot exemplars against ResNet50 baselines.
key_findings: Gemini-2.5 Pro reached 90.45% on ArtDL and 84.82% on ICONCLASS, beating ResNet50 baselines (84.44%, 40.46%). On Wikidata SigLIP-so400m was best (66.29%) while LLMs were ~45%. Descriptions generally helped in zero-shot; few-shot mostly lowered accuracy. Cross-dataset consistency was lower for LLMs than for contrastive models.
facets_explanation: Labels come from Iconclass codes already attached to images in ArtDL, the Iconclass AI Test Set and Wikidata; multi-label images were removed to keep a single label. Identifying the saint requires iconographic knowledge beyond the image itself. The paper does not discuss annotator disagreement.
results_explanation: Best score: "a peak of 90.45% achieved by Gemini-2.5 Pro" on ArtDL (Test 1, accuracy). The test configurations (labels, descriptions, few-shot) are prompting conditions rather than answer-format changes, so no format gap is recorded. No human baseline is reported. Dataset size is the sum of 1,864 + 863 + 718 images.

humanities_role.quote: Iconography, being that "branch of the history of art which concerns itself with the subject matter or meaning of works of art, as opposed to their form"

dataset_size.quote: The test set, published along with the paper, contains 1,864 images.
resulting in a dataset comprising 863 images.

gold_beyond_stimulus.quote: This configuration tests the model’s ability to leverage pre-trained knowledge connections between visual features and semantic concepts.
